description: Read a rikma's playbook - what its members wrote about how things are done there, why, and what is not done: the rikma-wide one, and one role's when roleId is given. Also returns the proposals to change it that are still open (silence approves them at their deadline), and - when no playbook exists yet - an outline of what a first one usually covers, with the facts the rikma already holds, to write it with the user. Members only. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#getPlaybookTool

roleId.description: A role (tafkid) id - also return that role's playbook.

name: getPlaybookTool
